purpose: Determine which original phrase-library lessons can have trustworthy note-by-note fretboard navigation without generating substitute phrases.

bopland.status: No authoritative machine-readable guitar-note source discovered in the inspected official pages and assets.
observations: Official project description states that notation is produced using LilyPond, but the inspected public lick page references PNG scores and MP3 playback only.
The official FAQ says no entire-database or combined-PDF download is offered. This is not proof that private source files do not exist.
The local official guitar index records IDs, progression groupings, meters and keys, but has no note events, note durations or string/fret positions.
The original Xbv40aTf PNG was manually inspected on the review date; all 28 original TAB positions and notated durations match the preserved lesson1297 source seed.
Treble-clef OMR from third parties is not authoritative guitar fingering/rhythm data and is not used. No transposed or regenerated phrases are used.
bopland.nextRequirement: For each additional ID, obtain authoritative note/rhythm/string-fret source data or manually verify every note against its original guitar score; separately verify any audio synchronization.

guitarset.method: Map existing source annotation JSON losslessly to sounding MIDI and the original source string/fret positions. Convert performance seconds to beats with originalBpm / 60 only for navigation; preserve original annotation fields.
limits: Dataset annotations are not independently hand-verified transcriptions.
Original fractional source MIDI, unrounded source time and source duration are retained; display frets and MIDI are the existing source-derived rounded semitones.
Existing chord metadata is one instructed-annotation sample at beat 2 of each bar. It does not establish exact in-bar chord-change timing.
Original cropped live MP3 and performance TAB SVG are reused unchanged. Their hashes are checked against the existing provenance manifest.
